svg.title: Shipboard: controller overlay concept at 1280 by 800
svg.desc: A review sheet showing a native pointer with an additive controller companion, navigation selection around an original row, three aiming states, and a text keyboard. Concept only; no game UI is replaced.
svg.text: Native arrow remains at the true hotspot.
Outline and marker identify controller focus.
Open centre preserves the weapon aim point.
All shapes are new SectorPad overlay studies. Browser font approximates Insignia; game fonts stay in the game.
